answer: Each identity keeps one distinct racing-pigeon loft registered as its haven, coordinates cut into a shale marker and its band registry locked in a public vault. Monthly, verifiers release one banded bird from a random site 30 km away; it must return and trigger the loft scanner within 3 hours, band matching the vault record. So 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 lofts at $420 each, $35 monthly feed per loft ($35,000 monthly), plus daily care; a shared loft, swapped band or missed return revokes the slot. Trade-off: rural lofts qualify faster than city agents.
